notes: The copula goes to `לַיְלָה`, which the Hebrew fronts as the predicate, while `אוֹר` is the subject; the Hebrew clause and not the English word order decides this (rule 20).
The waw takes the connective *If* the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
The marginal *Or, cover* and *Or, Then the night shall be light about me* were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
